tools.name: discover_calculators
tools.description: Finds the narrowest deterministic QuoteBuild calculator for a UK building task.

tools.name: prepare_calculation
tools.description: Returns the exact questions and typed inputs required before a deterministic calculation can run.

tools.name: run_calculation
tools.description: Runs one versioned QuoteBuild formula. Missing inputs use disclosed example defaults; confirm them and labour inclusion before drafting. Rates are baseline allowances. The model must not calculate monetary totals itself.

tools.name: compare_calculations
tools.description: Runs and compares up to five scenarios using the same versioned QuoteBuild formula.

tools.name: review_estimate_scope
tools.description: Checks line completeness, unresolved scope and zero rates without changing the estimate. This does not establish construction scope completeness or readiness to quote.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Lists the signed-in user’s jobs. Client contact details and full addresses are omitted unless clients:read is granted.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Gets one owned job with client data redacted unless clients:read is granted.

tools.name: get_estimate
tools.description: Gets the latest or requested immutable estimate version for one owned job.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Gets one owned quote and its recipient-visible pack data.

tools.name: get_job_financials
tools.description: Returns current estimate, quote, cost, variation and invoice totals for one owned job.

tools.name: list_variations
tools.description: Lists variations belonging to one owned job.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Lists invoices belonging to one owned job.

tools.name: list_job_files
tools.description: Lists job photos and files without exposing private storage credentials.

tools.name: get_business_report
tools.description: Returns aggregate business and margin totals for an owned date range.

tools.name: get_billing_status
tools.description: Returns subscription and trial entitlement status, never payment-card data.

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Creates an owned job draft. This does not contact the client.

tools.name: save_estimate_draft
tools.description: Creates a new immutable estimate version; it never overwrites the last valid version.

tools.name: create_quote_draft
tools.description: Creates an unsent quote from an owned, versioned estimate and recalculates every monetary total inside QuoteBuild.

tools.name: add_job_cost
tools.description: Adds one actual or forecast job cost to an owned job.

tools.name: prepare_job_evidence_upload
tools.description: Creates a one-time, ten-minute secure image upload for a supplier receipt, customer payment proof or job evidence. Uploading proof never marks an invoice as paid.

tools.name: attach_job_file
tools.description: Registers a host-provided file after upload reservation validation. It never performs OCR or plan reading.

tools.name: create_variation_draft
tools.description: Creates an unsent variation draft and calculates its amount from the supplied reviewed lines inside QuoteBuild.

tools.name: create_invoice_draft
tools.description: Creates an unsent invoice draft and calculates its amount from the supplied reviewed lines inside QuoteBuild.

tools.name: prepare_invoice_payment_record
tools.description: Shows the exact unpaid invoice and records a one-use ten-minute confirmation. It does not mark the invoice paid.

tools.name: record_invoice_payment
tools.description: Marks the exact prepared invoice as paid only after an explicit, one-use confirmation. It never contacts the customer or payment provider.

tools.name: prepare_quote_send
tools.description: Previews the exact current quote recipient and payload, then stores a one-use ten-minute confirmation token. This does not send.

tools.name: send_quote
tools.description: Sends the exact prepared quote payload after validating the one-use confirmation token.

tools.name: prepare_variation_send
tools.description: Previews the exact current variation recipient and payload, then stores a one-use ten-minute confirmation token. This does not send.

tools.name: send_variation
tools.description: Sends the exact prepared variation payload after validating the one-use confirmation token.

tools.name: prepare_invoice_send
tools.description: Previews the exact current invoice recipient and payload, then stores a one-use ten-minute confirmation token. This does not send.

tools.name: send_invoice
tools.description: Sends the exact prepared invoice payload after validating the one-use confirmation token.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_job_files" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Lists job photos and files without exposing private storage credentials.
